title: LIS boundary repaired
selected_for: illustration of observed paired outcomes, not a random sample
instruction:
Write a function to find the length of the longest increasing subsequence of the given sequence.

精确输入域与验收约定：非空整数列表，长度<=30；返回严格递增子序列的最大长度，子序列不要求连续。
修复 solution.py 中的 longest_increasing_subsequence 函数，保留签名。

tool_response.output:
import unittest
from solution import longest_increasing_subsequence

class PublicTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_public_01(self):
        actual = longest_increasing_subsequence(*[[10, 22, 9, 33, 21, 50, 41, 60]])
        expected = 5
        self.assertIs(type(actual), type(expected))
        self.assertEqual(actual, expected)

    def test_public_02(self):
        actual = longest_increasing_subsequence(*[[3, 10, 2, 1, 20]])
        expected = 3
        self.assertIs(type(actual), type(expected))
        self.assertEqual(actual, expected)
